probe.name: delete-source-first
probe.source:
Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim w As Worksheet,f As Object,s As String
s="active=" & ActiveSheet.Name
For Each w In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "|sheet=" & w.Name & ";count=" & CStr(w.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In w.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "{class=" & TypeName(f) & ";range=" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ";priority=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";color=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";index=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"ColorIndex") & ";dupe=" & P(f,"DupeUnique") & ";rank=" & P(f,"Rank") & "}"
Next
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function ReadCopied() As String
Worksheets("Copied").Activate
ReadCopied=Snapshot()
End Function
Function ReadOriginal() As String
Worksheets("Data").Activate
ReadOriginal=Snapshot()
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim src As Worksheet,cp As Worksheet,h As Object,f As Object,target As Object,s As String,stage As String,n As Long,d As String
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="copy"
Set src=Worksheets("Data")
src.Activate
src.Copy After:=src
Set cp=ActiveSheet
cp.Name="Copied"
cp.Activate
Set h=cp.Range("D20:D22").FormatConditions.AddTop10
h.Rank=3
h.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbYellow
stage="before"
s="before-copy=[" & ReadCopied() & "];before-original=[" & ReadOriginal() & "]"
stage="select"
Worksheets("Data").Activate
Set target=Worksheets("Data").Cells.FormatConditions(2)
stage="delete:" & P(target,"Priority")
target.Delete
stage="after"
Probe=s & ";after-copy=[" & ReadCopied() & "];after-original=[" & ReadOriginal() & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
d=Err.Description
On Error Resume Next
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(n) & ":" & stage & ":" & d & ";before=[" & s & "];copy=[" & ReadCopied() & "];original=[" & ReadOriginal() & "]"
End Function
